definitions.explanation: The art or craft of decorating fabric with needle and thread.

examples.japanese: {刺繍|ししゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{施|ほどこ}した→施す：12985_hodokosu⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧。

{刺繍|ししゅう} refers to both the craft of embroidery and the embroidered design itself. The kanji ⟦{刺|し}→刺：noentry⟧ means "to pierce" and ⟦{繍|しゅう}→繍：noentry⟧ means "to embroider," reflecting the needlework process.

- {刺繍|ししゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put in embroidery
- ⟦{刺繍糸|ししゅういと}→刺繍糸：noentry⟧: embroidery thread
- ⟦{刺繍針|ししゅうばり}→刺繍針：noentry⟧: embroidery needle

- ⟦{日本刺繍|にほんししゅう}→日本刺繍：noentry⟧: Japanese embroidery (uses silk thread on silk fabric)
- ⟦フランス→フランス：19418_furansu⟧{刺繍|ししゅう}: French embroidery
